They are part of the [[green dragonhide armour]] set, and can be worn at level 40 [[Ranged]]. They offer the best ranged accuracy bonus out of all [[free-to-play]] leg armours, although their defensive bonuses are surpassed by the [[gilded d'hide chaps]]. Notable for no [[Defence]] requirement, this piece of armour is commonly used by the [[Free-to-play combat pure guide|free-to-play combat pures]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash
